name: barbell wide stance stiff leg deadlift
description: A stiff-legged deadlift with a wide stance that brings in the inner thighs and glutes. It also keeps the hamstrings under a deep stretch.
instructions: Take a wide stance, toes slightly out, with the barbell held in front of your thighs.
Keep your knees nearly straight and push your hips back.
Lower the bar between your legs while keeping your back flat.
Stop when you feel a strong stretch in the hamstrings and inner thighs.
Squeeze your glutes to rise back to standing.
